name: Shigaraki Tateyuki
source:
Eddie Fender is a defense attorney who was Gregory Edgeworth's investigative partner when the latter was alive, with the IS-7 Incident being a notable case in which the two worked together. When he met his former mentor's son Miles Edgeworth years later, he questioned Miles about his chosen path of being a prosecutor, rather than becoming a defense attorney like his father.

[From [url=https://aceattorney.fandom.com/wiki/Eddie_Fender]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
